description: Immutable public EU Pollinator Hub MUST-B (2019-2020) raw archive; held subset is spatial context only.

files.note: Publisher ZIP downloaded through the current public complete-dataset link resolved from the stable EU Pollinator Hub landing page; archive bytes are retained unchanged. The ZIP holds only site and botanical-survey-polygon coordinate data, not the portal-listed colony, management, laboratory, pesticide, resource or observation tables. It has no RF measurements and must not feed CSLI or a causal join.

retrieval_method: Resolved short-lived public complete-dataset URL from stable landing page https://app.pollinatorhub.eu/dataset-discovery/MUSTB76.0.0; stored publisher ZIP bytes unchanged
